(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 Oktober 2027.

OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH ACT 1994

OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH

(PROHIBITION OF USE OF SUBSTANCE) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 35 of the

Occupational Safety and Health Act 1994 [Act 514], the Director General of

Occupational Safety and Health makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Occupational Safety and Health

(Prohibition of Use of Substance) Order 2026.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 October 2027.

Prohibition of use of substance

2. (1) The substances listed in column (2) of the Schedule shall be prohibited

from use to the extent as specified in column (4) of the Schedule.

(2) For the purposes of this paragraph, "Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS)

Registry Number" listed in column (3) of the Schedule means a unique identification

number assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service, United States of America for every

chemical substance.

Revocation

3. The Occupational Safety and Health (Prohibition of Use of Substance) Order 1999

[P.U. (A) 303/1999] is revoked.
